description: Fetch detailed information for a specific plugin given its vendor/package name, including security advisories, readme, and version history.

include_readme.description: Whether to include the full README markdown content in the response.

include_security_advisories.description: Whether to include security advisory information (CVEs, active advisories) in the response.

include_versions.description: Whether to include the versions array in the response.

package.description: Full Composer package name in the form "vendor/package".

name: get-plugin-details-tool

laraplugins_url.description: Human-readable plugin detail page on laraplugins.io for sharing with users

markdown_link.description: Markdown version of the detail page

optional_fields.description: List of fields available by passing the corresponding include_* parameter

is_laraplugins_secure.description: Whether the plugin passes the LaraPlugins Secure badge criteria.

resolved_count.description: Number of advisories resolved in later or unknown versions.

unpatched_count.description: Number of unpatched advisories affecting the current version.

worst_severity.description: Worst severity among unpatched advisories (critical, high, medium, low).

title: Get Plugin Details Tool
